intent: Bootstrap the foundational architecture for the NovaPulse engine, establishing a high-performance ECS (Entity Component System) framework and core utility modules.
architecture_impact: Introduces a modular, decoupled architecture based on an ECS pattern. It establishes strict separation between data (components), logic (systems), and orchestration (world), while providing low-level math and event-handling utilities.

{'file': 'src/ecs/world.js', 'change_summary': 'Created the central registry for entities and system orchestration using bitmask-based archetype queries.'}
{'file': 'src/ecs/components.js', 'change_summary': 'Defined plain data containers for simulation state to ensure memory efficiency.'}
{'file': 'src/ecs/systems.js', 'change_summary': 'Implemented core simulation logic, including movement and autonomous agent behavior.'}
{'file': 'tests/engine.test.js', 'change_summary': 'Added a comprehensive test suite to validate engine subsystems and simulation logic.'}
functionality_gained: The engine is now capable of running a full simulation loop, managing entity lifecycles, performing vector-based physics calculations, and executing autonomous agent behaviors within a browser-based canvas environment.
